title: Just 10 minutes of AI use may erode persistence on hard tasks
script:
Ten minutes of AI use kills your persistence.
Researchers from UC Berkeley, MIT, and Oxford conducted this study.
Participants used AI to solve basic fraction problems and SAT reading tasks.
Those using AI tools were significantly less likely to persist on difficult prompts.
The team presented these findings at the Conference on Language Modeling.
This shift in behavior suggests AI affects how we approach challenging work.
Do you feel less patient when using AI tools?
